thread:
incident-bot: SEV3 pager — embedder latency spike in prod-us-east1. 20% of embeddings requests >2s over last 5m. paging oncall.

raj_oncall: On it. digging into embedder pods and routing. Starting mitigation: re-route traffic to standby pool, warming kv cache.

lina_eng: Noted similar error traces: repeated gRPC timeouts to embedder shard 7. posting logs.

lina_eng: ```
ERROR embedder/handler.go: timeout fetching embeddings for batch id=... latency=2500ms
```

toni_sre: @raj_oncall please confirm customer impact and whether we should run emergency fallback to smaller model.

raj_oncall: @sara_product which customers reported UI issues? I see elevated 5xx for tenant acme-inc and some front-end alerts.

sara_product: Confirmed — Acme experiencing slow search results. They called support ~10m ago. No SLA breach yet but UX degraded. cc @kate_pm

kate_pm: Thx. Customer impact = partial degrad; internal priority = high for next-day remediation.

devops-bot: Deploy 26678 rolled ~09:14 UTC to prod-us-east1 (user: lina_eng). No rollbacks so far.

raj_oncall: Rolled traffic to standby, KV cache warmup in progress. Latency dropping in tail but some shards still high.

toni_sre: Can you try scaled-down batch sizes on the noisy nodes? That helped in staging last week.

lina_eng: Reducing batch_size from 256 -> 64 on shard 7 now. Monitoring.

raj_oncall: Batch change pushed. 5xx and tail latency trending down to ~700ms. Still watching for regressions.

incident-bot: Mitigation acknowledged. Page updated: mitigation in progress, oncall=raj_oncall, impact=partial.

sara_product: Thanks team. Customer notified via support with ETA 30m.

raj_oncall: We stabilized. Will do a controlled rollback of recent model config if recurrence in 1h.

toni_sre: Let's plan a postmortem. Propose Thurs 10:00 UTC for 60m, include eng-runtime, infra, product, SRE.

kate_pm: Works for me. I'll add customer context and severity assessment to the notes.

lina_eng: I'll own technical write-up + logs. Estimating 2 days to collect artifacts and reproduce locally.

toni_sre: Action items — let's capture and size now:
- Add per-shard latency alerts + runbook link (owner: lina_eng, size: small, 1-2d)
- KV cache eviction policy tuning and metrics (owner: toni_sre, size: medium, 3-5d)
- Add rolling rollback guard in deploy pipeline for embedder model changes (owner: raj_oncall, size: small, 1-3d)
- Experiment: dynamic batch sizing based on queue depth (owner: lina_eng, size: large, 2+ sprints)

kate_pm: Mapping to Q2 roadmap: KV tuning -> OKR infra reliability. Prioritize medium in sprint 1.

sara_product: Customer follow-up task: outreach + summary + mitigation steps (owner: kate_pm, size: small, 0.5-1d)

raj_oncall: I'll create tickets now and link them here. Creating a parent incident card in tracker: https://tracker.internal/INC-8921

raj_oncall: Tickets created:
- INC-8922 add shard latency alerts (est 1d)
- INC-8923 kv eviction metrics (est 4d)
- INC-8924 rollback guard (est 2d)
- INC-8925 dynamic batching RFC (est 3w)

toni_sre: Good. Severity mapping: this is sev3 (partial customer impact) -> prioritize medium-high. Recommend scheduling INC-8923 into next sprint and INC-8924 as immediate hotfix.

kate_pm: I'll slot customer follow-up and communication into next-day priorities.

lina_eng: Will start reproducer for shard 7 today. Expect initial findings by EOD.

sara_product: Postmortem owner: @toni_sre. Lina, Raj, Kate, and I will be reporters/attendees.

toni_sre: Confirmed. Postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-8921

raj_oncall: Oncall handoff: handing to @maria_oncall at 18:00 UTC. I'll add notes in handoff doc.

maria_oncall: Thanks @raj_oncall — I'll monitor for 2h and follow up on any regressions.

sara_product: Closing note: immediate mitigation worked; follow-ups are scoped and sized. Thanks all :tada:

kate_pm: Adding action items to quarterly planning board under Reliability -> Embedding stability.

incident-bot: Thread marked resolved. Reminder: postmortem meeting Thu 10:00 UTC. RSVP if attending.

raj_oncall: closing thread — feel free to ping me for any follow-ups.

maria_oncall: ack :white_check_mark:
